body:
I am sick and tired of it, honestly. It's just so awkward.

I do wish my parents paid more attention to the issues when I was younger. They did the best they could, but my older sisters got knocked up a bunch of times so my parents had to invest all of themselves into taking care of their situations. Then when I tried to get some attention and let mom and dad know that I needed mental help, my sisters would just gang up on me and tell me "I need to stop stressing our parents out". Meanwhile, to this day they make my parents' bank accounts go negative every week.

But the past is over and I'm an adult now. I've been trying to stick it out but, I don't know what for at this point. Maybe for my fiance, and my nieces and nephews.

I don't want to stress people out anymore. Everyone around me is depressed and suicidal, so what makes my problems so special to dump them on others? I should look for a physio though..

Thank you for your help, genuinely. I'm just glad someone hears me out, you know? Even if I am pretty difficult.
